slots.notes: Three distinct fullscreen object-cover looping background videos, one per bento card: BackgroundCard (career-timeline card), RaisedStatCard (the huge 10M+ stat), and DailySoftwareCard. Each rendered autoPlay loop muted playsInline, absolute inset-0 object-cover behind a tracking-wide section label and overlaid white content, so footage must be dark / low-contrast to keep the white text legible. Native prompt hardcodes three separate CloudFront MP4 URLs (these are sockets to fill, not values to keep).

Tool/brand glyphs for the two scrolling marquee rows in DailySoftwareCard, each mounted in a liquid-glass tile (h-14 w-14 md:h-16 md:w-16, rounded-xl). 16 tile positions total: row 1 scrolls left with 8 [Figma, Framer, Palette, PenTool, Layers, Type, Aperture, Chrome], row 2 scrolls right with 8 [Camera, Brush, Box, Wand2, Figma, Framer, Type, Layers] (12 unique glyphs across the two rows; some repeat). Each row is duplicated in markup for a seamless loop. Native source is lucide-react at strokeWidth 1.5; reskin swaps to the brand's actual daily-software stack as monochrome line icons so the glass tile shows through. Transparent (alpha) required.

Functional UI chrome glyphs (not brand assets): Sparkle, used both as the decorative pair flanking every uppercase section label and as the year/role separator in the BackgroundCard timeline (h-3 w-3, strokeWidth 1.5, text-white/60-70); and ArrowUpRight inside the ReachMeCard round button (h-9 w-9 rounded-full). Native source is lucide-react; only swap if the brand ships an equivalent line-icon system.

Single UI typeface for the heading, intro body, the huge 10M+ stat (font-light), and all uppercase section labels. Native declaration is Inter with antialiased smoothing and a system fallback. Display sizes use tracking-tight and section labels use tracking-[0.22em] uppercase, so any replacement should be a clean geometric/grotesque sans with tight tracking tolerance to preserve the single-screen lg:h-screen fit.

mechanic: A full-viewport (lg:h-screen) dark 3-column bento grid of rounded-2xl cards layered over autoplaying looping background videos, whose signature motion is two opposed CSS-keyframe icon marquees (22s left / 26s right, edge-masked) reading through liquid-glass gradient-border tiles.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + lucide-react, with the liquid-glass gradient-border, marquee keyframes, and SVG-feTurbulence noise-overlay hand-authored in index.css.
reskinNotes: Surfaces are baked into raw CSS rather than tokens: card surface #324444 and bg #0a0a0a are hardcoded inline (bg-[#324444], bg-black); the noise-overlay is an inline SVG feTurbulence data-URI with its white-tint hex encoded in the feColorMatrix; the liquid-glass border is a fixed white-alpha linear-gradient driven by -webkit-mask-composite:xor / mask-composite:exclude, so retinting to a dark/non-white accent means editing CSS, not config. All copy (headline, intro paragraph, three timeline rows, testimonial quote + Elena Brooks attribution, the 10M+ stat and 'Raised for startups' caption, hi@maxreed.com, +44 207 81 63, the CTA and every section label) is hardcoded in JSX. Marquee icon membership and per-row direction/speed are literal lucide imports plus fixed 22s/26s animation durations. Section labels depend on tracking-[0.22em] uppercase and the heading on tracking-tight at responsive sizes, so a wider/narrower replacement font will shift the single-screen bento fit.
